translations.web: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.
translations.bsb: They cried out to You and were set free; they trusted in You and were not disappointed.
translations.kjv: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.
translations.asv: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: They trusted in thee, and were not put to shame.
